containers.name: a
command:
set -eu
count=$(env | grep -c "^DRA_METADATA_PHYSICAL_" || true)
test "$count" -eq 1
test -r "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"apiVersion":"metadata.resource.k8s.io/v1beta1"' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"model":{"string":"validation-widget"}' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
test ! -e "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
echo "metadata a passed"
sleep 3600

containers.name: b
command:
set -eu
count=$(env | grep -c "^DRA_METADATA_PHYSICAL_" || true)
test "$count" -eq 1
test ! -e "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
test -r "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"apiVersion":"metadata.resource.k8s.io/v1beta1"' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"model":{"string":"validation-widget"}' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
echo "metadata b passed"
sleep 3600

containers.name: all
command:
set -eu
count=$(env | grep -c "^DRA_METADATA_PHYSICAL_" || true)
test "$count" -eq 2
test -r "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"apiVersion":"metadata.resource.k8s.io/v1beta1"' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"model":{"string":"validation-widget"}' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
if (echo broken > "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"); then exit 17; fi
test -r "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"apiVersion":"metadata.resource.k8s.io/v1beta1"' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
grep -F '"model":{"string":"validation-widget"}' "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
if (echo broken > "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"); then exit 17; fi
echo "metadata all passed"
sleep 3600

containers.name: none
command:
set -eu
count=$(env | grep -c "^DRA_METADATA_PHYSICAL_" || true)
test "$count" -eq 0
test ! -e "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/a/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
test ! -e "$DRA_METADATA_BASE/b/dra.example.com-metadata.json"
echo "metadata none passed"
sleep 3600
